purpose.summary: This program implements a CGI web-based query screen for performance items (Consulta Foco Performance). It handles pagination (previous/next page, go-to), reads from a performance item file (pd83800), and renders an HTML table listing product codes, IC codes, product groups, PGV codes, packaging, and descriptions.
